hypothesis.title: Overlay integration on C_softmax baseline (AR threshold + M4 regime)
hypothesis.description_brief: PG2 강화 path. PD30 C_softmax z-composite 4-sleeve baseline (KR equity 0.55 + TSMOM 0.225 + KR_10y 0.18 + Cash 0.045, admitted research_foundation_candidate via PD34) 위 AR threshold pure overlay (β_t scalar emission, K=5/W=252/q70=0.4172/q90=0.4502/β∈[0.4,0.7,1.0]) + M4 regime overlay (NORMAL=1.0/CAUTION partial/CRISIS=0) 결합. 3 coupling specs: multiplicative / min / linear blend. 가설: 두 overlay가 KR equity sleeve의 systemic-risk + regime-conditional drawdown을 단축, 4-sleeve baseline 대비 risk-adjusted 우위 (MDD 개선 vs SR 유지 또는 양쪽 개선).

economic_mechanism.ar_overlay: AR (Kritzman-Page-Turkington 2011 FAJ): cross-sectional eigenvalue 집중도 → systemic risk 진단. 높은 AR 국면 (q90+) = market mode dominance + diversification 한계. β_t = 0.4 / 0.7 / 1.0 threshold step exposure reduction. 학술 근거: Kritzman et al. (2010) PCA-based systemic risk + Page-Turkington (2011) FAJ implementation. KR empirical: WT-S20260504_007 + WT-P20260504_001 256m PASS.
economic_mechanism.m4_overlay: M4 regime BOCPD trend decay + Bayesian linear combination. NORMAL=1.0 / CAUTION partial sizing (0.43~0.85) / CRISIS=0. Regime window 전전월말 → 당월말 close-to-close (L-274 fix). 학술 근거: Adams-MacKay (2007) Bayesian Online Change Point Detection. KR empirical: STR_1715 base SR 1.685 → M4 SR 1.767 (+SR 0.082, +MDD 6.37pp). admit 2026-04-30.
economic_mechanism.coupling_thesis: AR (cross-sectional eigenvalue 집중도) ⊥ M4 (time-series trend decay) — 정의상 다른 정보 dimension. WT-P20260504_001 STR_1715 case에서 AR-on-M4 sequentially layered → SR 1.767 → 1.776 (+0.009) + MDD -35.32% → -25.15% (+10.17pp). 4-sleeve C_softmax baseline에서도 동일 시너지 expected.

headline_finding.interpretation: 3 coupling specs ALL reduce SR (-0.026 ~ -0.057) while modestly improving MDD (+2.04 ~ +3.89pp). C2 (min) has best Calmar gain (+0.0064) — single positive risk-adjusted move. SR loss not compensated by MDD gain at 0.5 × MDD shift rate. Hypothesis: 4-sleeve C_softmax baseline already absorbs much of overlay-targetable risk via sleeve diversification (TSMOM crisis hedge + KR_10y bond + Cash). KR equity sleeve overlay reduces both upside + downside, but baseline composite already operates at lower vol regime than single-sleeve STR_1715 → overlay marginal benefit thin.

honest_findings.primary_conclusion: Overlay (AR + M4) coupling on C_softmax baseline does NOT produce strict-dominant alpha enhancement. All 3 coupling specs reduce SR (0.97 → 0.91-0.94) while improving MDD (-22.94% → -19.05 to -20.90%). Best risk-adjusted profile: C2 (min) — Calmar 0.685 (vs C0 0.679, +0.0064). Net assessment: marginal at best.
honest_findings.structural_explanation: C_softmax 4-sleeve baseline already incorporates crisis hedging via TSMOM (22.5%) + KR_10y bond (18%) + Cash (4.5%) = 45% non-KR-equity allocation. Overlay specs apply additional risk reduction to KR equity sleeve (55%), creating redundancy with sleeve diversification. The 'AR + M4 → SR + MDD both improve' result on STR_1715 (single-sleeve top20 long_only) does NOT transfer to multi-sleeve composite — different risk regime.
implications_for_pg2: Overlay integration on C_softmax baseline is NOT a clear path to PG2 enhancement at current sleeve allocation (55% KR equity).

Three alternative paths emerge for PG2 enhancement: (a) higher KR equity sleeve weight (e.g., 0.70) where overlay marginal benefit increases; (b) overlay on TSMOM or KR_10y sleeve separately (uncorrelated risk); (c) alternative coupling (AR triggers TSMOM allocation increase, not KR equity reduction).
T+30 grace clause GC7 strictly requires overlay activation; this cycle DOCUMENTS GC7 fulfillment with negative finding. Path (a)(b)(c) explored in follow-up WTs.
